title: A drifted contact menu alias resolves only through one exact native contact body
steps: Run contact-route write tests through the existing native door adapters.
expect: One exact contact body resolves form closure, metadata, page links and slug writes to the same menu item; restoration uses its actual original alias.
The canonical kit path retains precedence even if it opens a different entity.
Ambiguous owners, duplicate menus, unrelated contacts, other components, unsafe rows and duplicate identity query fields remain unresolved.
fence: Preserve exact-path precedence and refuse uncertain ownership; do not infer from titles or aliases. No paid calls or live site mutations.

tests: one exact contact owner unifies form, metadata, link and slug writes despite live alias drift
an exact published kit path retains precedence over contact-owner fallback
contact fallback refuses ambiguity, unrelated owners, other components and unsafe menu rows
